fixed: ninne raatri IPL pandya nodalu tadavaaguvavaregoo echcharavaagidde, nanna Rajasthan Royals koneya overnalli geddithu, entha pandya!

problem: rom 'adannu' (ಅದನ್ನು) differs from nat ಅದನ್ನೇ (adanne); not the same word
fixed: pratidina ippattu nimisha appnalli Tamil abhyaasa maaduttene, nanna hosa sahodyogigalu madhyaahnada ootadalli adanne maatanaaduttaare, nanage ontitana anisuttade.
